First, I remember that the Albanian Fascist Party, or PFSh, was formed during World War II. They came to power after Italy invaded Albania in 1939. So, they must have started their rule around that time. But I'm not exactly sure about the exact end year.

I think the end of their power was around 1943 because that's when Italy surrendered to the Allies. After that, Germany took over Albania, so the PFSh's influence probably diminished. But I've also heard some sources mention 1944, especially regarding the German occupation. So, there's a bit of confusion there.

I need to check reliable sources to confirm the exact end year. I'll look up Britannica and university history pages to see what they say. If they all point to 1943, that's probably the correct answer. If there's a mix, I'll note the discrepancy but go with the most widely accepted year, which is 1943.
